translations.web: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.
translations.bsb: You are to say, ‘I am a sign to you.’ Just as it happened here, so will it be done to them; they will go into exile as captives.
translations.kjv: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
translations.asv: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them; they shall go into exile, into captivity.
